description.value:
Trigger You Cut Grafts during your daily preparations.

Choose up to three Grafts you prepare today. Each is Overpacked: when thrown, its splash damage equals your Intelligence modifier plus your level instead of its normal splash, but on a miss it bursts in your own square rather than the target’s.

cinderfall.incomplete: Splash damage isn't a rule-element-exposed field on a consumable item, and "detonates in your own square on a miss" has no selector either.
